jobs.title: Head of Brand & Product Marketing
jobs.description:
Workstream is a mission-driven company building the all-in-one HR, payroll, and hiring platform for managing the hourly workforce. There are 2.7 billion hourly workers, making up 80% of the global workforce, but this market has been heavily underserved by technology and deserves better. Workstream has been purpose-built for the hourly workforce from day one so that these businesses and their employees can thrive.

Our customers include leading brands from multiple sectors, including Burger King, Carl's Jr./Hardee's, IHOP, KFC, and Culvers. We are a high growth series B company and quickly expanding our product portfolio to deliver on our vision. We are backed by legendary VCs and industry experts like Founders Fund, BOND, and Coatue.

Grow With Us

We are looking for a  Head of Brand & Product Marketing  to join our team. This is building, not maintaining. You will own how Workstream is positioned, launched, and remembered, at the moment we expand from a vertical SaaS leader into an AI-native platform for the entire frontline workforce. You'll run product marketing, brand, content, and design as one team, report directly to our revenue leadership, and see your work show up in the pipeline within weeks, not quarters.

We are looking for leaders that thrive in a fast-paced environment. Ex-founders thrive here.

Location & Relocation

- This is a 4 to 5-days-per-week in-office role . We believe being together is important for building quickly, collaborating closely, and shaping the next chapter of Workstream

- We support relocation and visa sponsorship for the right candidate

Day In The Life

- Positioning & Narrative: Own Workstream's positioning and messaging end to end, including the biggest open strategic question we have: leading with our restaurant dominance vs. the broader frontline-workforce story. You'll test it, not debate it.

- Product Launches:  Run GTM launches for a portfolio that now ships AI products (like our AI assistant for frontline teams) alongside hiring, HR, and payroll. Messaging, pricing & packaging input, launch plans, and the enablement that makes Sales dangerous in the first week.

- Brand & Content:  Lead our content and design team across the website, case studies, video, webinars, and social. Raise the bar on everything customer-facing, and use AI to produce at a pace a team twice our size couldn't match a year ago.

- Working with Sales:  Arm AEs and partnerships with narratives, competitive teardowns, ROI stories, and customer proof. Sit in on deals. Talk to lost prospects. Change the message when the market tells you to.

- Team Leadership:  Manage and grow a small, high-output team of product marketers, content marketers, and designers, and be the strongest IC on it when it matters.

Who You Are

- Slope over pedigree: 5+ years in B2B marketing with real product marketing depth, but we care more about what you've shipped and how fast you're improving than the logos on your resume.

- Management experience : You have built and led hungry and dynamic marketing teams in the past.

- Founder energy: you've started something (a company, a category, a function from zero) and you default to action; former founders welcome!

- A writer and an operator: you produce sharp positioning yourself, and you build systems so the team produces it without you.

- AI-native: you already use AI agents across your daily work and you'll push the team to do the same.

- Commercially ruthless: you measure marketing in pipeline and revenue, not impressions.

- Hungry: you outwork the market and you want the scope of a VP role earlier than a big company would ever give it to you.

- Experience with SMB buyers, hourly/frontline workforces, HR tech, or payroll is a strong plus.

Travel & Location

- Based in (or relocating to) San Francisco; in-office at least 4 days per week

- Occasional travel for customer visits, conferences, and team events

What We Offer

- A mission-driven and value-based company dedicated to empowering deskless workers and local businesses

- An early employee opportunity at a Series B hyper-growth startup with over $120M in funding

- Work directly with the founding team and industry veterans to accelerate your career

- Competitive salary and equity

- Comprehensive health coverage: medical, dental, and vision. We pay 95% of your premiums for employees and 85% for dependents

- In-office amenities and stocked kitchen

- 401K plan

- Flexible PTO

Salary Range

The base salary range for this role is $160,000 and $190,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this role includes participation in Workstream's stock option program, offering meaningful equity ownership in the company.
Know More About Workstream

- https://www.workstream.us/blog/funding-series-b

- https://techcrunch.com/2021/08/26/workstreams-text-based-recruitment-tool-gets-a-48m-bet-from-bond-and-beyond/

- https://techbuzz.news/buzzworthy-august-27-2021/

We are committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.location: Menlo Park, San Francisco, Lehi, Vancouver
jobs.description:
Workstream is a mission-driven company building the all-in-one HR, payroll, and hiring platform for managing the hourly workforce. There are 2.7 billion hourly workers, making up 80% of the global workforce, but this market has been heavily underserved by technology and deserves better. Workstream has been purpose-built for the hourly workforce from day one so that these businesses and their employees can thrive.

Our customers include leading brands from multiple sectors, including Burger King, Carl's Jr./Hardee's, IHOP, KFC, and Culvers. We are a high growth series B company and quickly expanding our product portfolio to deliver on our vision. We are backed by legendary VCs and industry experts like Founders Fund, BOND, and Coatue.

Grow With Us

We are looking for a highly customer-obsessed, strategic, and execution-driven Product Manager to own key product areas across Workstream’s platform.

You'll own your product area end-to-end — defining its strategy, roadmap, and long-term vision. From customer discovery and hypothesis development through execution, iteration, and measurable business outcomes, you'll shape the product narrative, set north-star metrics, and drive the investments that improve how hourly businesses hire, manage, and retain their workforce.

This role is built for someone who thrives in fast-paced startup environments, genuinely enjoys spending time with customers, and pairs sharp strategic thinking with relentless execution. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Customer Success, Business Development, and Leadership to surface opportunities, prioritize ruthlessly, and ship products that move the needle.

This is a full-time, hybrid position with 1 to 3 days a week in-office to support close cross-functional collaboration.

Day In The Life

- Own product strategy, roadmap, and execution for a core Workstream product area

- Define product vision, north star metrics, and success criteria aligned with company priorities

- Spend significant time with customers, users, and customer-facing teams to identify patterns, pain points, and emerging market opportunities

- Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Business Development, and Operations to gather business requirements and translate them into scalable product solutions

- Build and manage relationships with strategic external partners (e.g. job boards, integrations, ecosystem partners) and continuously improve product capabilities through these partnerships

- Conduct market, competitive, and customer research to develop and validate product hypotheses

- Take a hypothesis-driven, experimentation-first approach to product discovery and iteration

- Write detailed product specifications, user stories, and UX requirements that enable high-quality execution

- Collaborate closely with Engineering and Design teams to ship products quickly while balancing speed, quality, and long-term scalability

- Be highly resourceful and pragmatic in solving customer problems—whether through automation, integrations, operational workflows, or lightweight solutions

- Drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, and executive stakeholders

- Present product strategy, roadmap progress, and business impact across all levels of the organization

Who You Are

- 5 to 7+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in SaaS, growth, marketplace, or startup environments

- Experience utilizing AI to make you and your team more effective

- Understanding of AI landscape and tools

- Experience working in a fast-paced, scaling startup (typically <500 employees) or demonstrated ability to thrive in high-growth environments

- Proven track record of owning product initiatives from concept through launch (0→1) and iteration (1→N), incorporating both Go To Market and PLG motions

- Strong customer empathy and genuine enthusiasm for talking directly with users

- Excellent analytical, strategic, and hypothesis-driven problem-solving skills

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

- Strong partnership skills across Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Operations

- Ability to move quickly, prioritize effectively, and operate with resourcefulness in ambiguous environments

- Experience writing product specs, user stories, and translating business needs into product execution

Location Requirements

While we are looking for the best talent globally, the ideal candidate will be based in the San Francisco Bay Area to collaborate closely with our HQ. We are also open to candidates in Vancouver and Utah who can effectively manage the travel requirements between our primary hubs.

Nice To Have

- Experience in growth product management or marketplace products

- Experience with HR tech, hiring, payroll, scheduling, workforce management, or local business software

- Familiarity with job board ecosystems, integrations, or external platform partnerships

- Experience working with offshore or distributed engineering teams

- Background in hourly work industries such as restaurants, retail, hospitality, or frontline operations

- Experience with one or more of the following product categories: HRIS, Payroll, Scheduling, Time & Attendance, or Hiring

What We Offer

- A mission-driven and value-based company dedicated to empower deskless workers and local businesses

- An early employee opportunity at a Series B hyper-growth startup; work with the founding team and industry veterans to accelerate your career

- Competitive salary and equity

- Comprehensive health coverage: medical, dental, and vision. We pay 95% of your premiums for our employees and 85% for dependents

- 401K Plan

- Flexible PTO

Salary Range

In compliance with applicable pay transparency laws, the base salary range for this role varies by location:

- San Francisco and Menlo Park, CA: $150,000 to $170,000

- Lehi, UT: $130,000 to $150,000

- Vancouver, BC: $100,000 to $130,000

When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors, including skill set, experience, job scope, geographic location, and current market data.

Our customers include leading brands from multiple sectors, including Burger King, Carl's Jr./Hardee's, IHOP, KFC, and Culvers. We are a high growth series B company and quickly expanding our product portfolio to deliver on our vision. We are backed by legendary VCs and industry experts like Founders Fund, BOND, and Coatue.

Grow With Us

We are looking for a  Senior Product Marketing manager to join our team. This is a high-leverage PMM seat, owning positioning, launches, and sales enablement for a platform that is expanding from hiring into payroll, HR, and AI products. You report directly into revenue leadership, and will lead a team of 3 managing Product Marketing & owning the brand, with a lot of growth potential to take on more scope in the future!

We are looking for leaders that thrive in a fast-paced environment. Ex-founders thrive here.

Location & Relocation

- This is a 4 to 5-days-per-week in-office role at our San Francisco office . We believe being together is important for building quickly, collaborating closely, and shaping the next chapter of Workstream

- We support relocation and visa sponsorship for the right candidate

Day In The Life

- Positioning & Messaging: Own how we describe Workstream on the website, in decks, and in the first 30 seconds of every sales call. Test our biggest narrative question, restaurant-first vs. the broader frontline-workforce story, with real experiments, not opinions.

- Product Launches:  Run end-to-end GTM launches for new products, including our AI assistant for frontline teams and our expanding payroll suite: messaging, launch plan, pricing & packaging input, and post-launch iteration.

- Sales Enablement:  Build the battlecards, competitive teardowns, ROI narratives, and customer proof that make AEs win. Listen to calls weekly and update the message when the market talks back.

- Customer Proof & Content:  Turn customers like the biggest QSR brands in America into case studies, video stories, and webinars, working hand-in-hand with our content and design team.

- Ship With AI:  Use AI agents across research, drafting, and analysis to move at a pace that would have taken a full team a year ago. We expect it, and we'll teach you what we know.

Who You Are

- 3-10 years in product marketing or a mix of PMM and growth/content roles, ideally in B2B SaaS; what you've shipped matters more to us than your title history.

- Founder energy: you've built something from scratch (a company, a product, a channel) and you bias hard toward action; former founders welcome!

- Commercially minded: you judge your own work by pipeline influenced and deals won, and you actually enjoy talking to sales.

- AI-native: AI tools are already part of how you work every day.

- Hungry: you want more scope than your years "should" allow, and you're willing to earn it in person, in SF, with a team that works hard.

- Experience with SMB buyers, hourly/frontline workforces, HR tech, or payroll is a strong plus.
